statements: INV-009: at most one active grant per (viewer_id, project_id) and per (service_principal_id, project_id)

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-051 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal]; INV-053 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-051: every action in the audit catalog writes exactly one AuditRecord with actor provenance; service actors record key_version
INV-053: a rejected audit record of a significant mutation carries result=rejected and a closed reason_code
verdicts.why: The check detects rejected snapshot-import audit outcomes with catalogued reasons and verifies one audit row per exercised import. It does not inspect actor provenance or key_version, nor establish exactly-one auditing for every action in the audit catalog.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-022, INV-023, INV-024, INV-025 [witness: verification:budget_management_sqlite_uow_client_portal]; INV-020 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-020: an accepted ApprovedEstimateSnapshot is immutable; versions are append-only and never overwritten or deleted
INV-022: import and activation are distinct actions; a producer holds no activation capability and never activates its own import
INV-023: at most one active BudgetVersion per project; activation atomically deactivates the previous active version
INV-024: at most one manual BudgetVersion per project; manual section plans are mutable only while the project is active; imported plans are immutable copies of their snapshot
INV-025: PortalSection identity is stable across versions and renames; automatic linking uses source_key equality only; display-name matching is forbidden
verdicts.why: It checks that duplicate snapshot identifiers and identities are refused without changing stored counts, which is a limited append-only/immutability check for INV-020. It does not test deletion or mutation of accepted snapshots, and it asserts none of INV-022 through INV-025.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-052 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-052: audit records and import records are append-only; no flow mutates or deletes them
verdicts.why: The check refuses reuse of an import-record ID and shows replay creating a new import and audit row. It does not attempt or prohibit mutation or deletion of either audit records or import records generally.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: recorded reason equals exception reason [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements:
A snapshot import rejection's recorded reason equals the raised exception's
  `reason`, whatever its message text.
verdicts.why: It compares returned rejection reasons with expected catalog values and checks recorded audit reason codes. It does not compare the recorded reason directly with each raised exception's `reason`, and it does not vary exception message text.

statements: INV-009: at most one active grant per (viewer_id, project_id) and per (service_principal_id, project_id)

INV-030: one recognized_document_id creates at most one Expense and one ExpenseDocument; equal intake_fingerprint replay returns the existing records, while a different fingerprint is an integrity conflict changing nothing
INV-042: a WorkPayment is idempotent by payment_id and is never a factura or accounting posting; payments total is derived
INV-043: a ProgressPhoto is idempotent by intake_id; the gallery is chronological; visibility changes never alter financial or progress data
verdicts.why: The check exercises INV-021's identical-publication replay and changed-fingerprint integrity conflict while confirming no additional snapshot is stored. It does not assert INV-009, INV-030, INV-042, or INV-043.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-037 [witness: verification:project_tracking_audit_writer_sqlite_uow_client_portal]; INV-037 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal]; INV-041 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-037: all monetary values are EUR with decimal 2-digit semantics and ROUND_HALF_UP; foreign currency input is rejected explicitly, never converted
INV-041: completed work value and overall progress follow the R9 formulas; overall progress is unavailable, never guessed, when no planned work cost exists
verdicts.why: It explicitly detects foreign-currency input as a currency mismatch. It does not establish two-digit decimal semantics or ROUND_HALF_UP behavior, and it does not test the completed-work or overall-progress formulas in INV-041.
